summary: 11 of the relevance_gate corpus's 40 cases now name a REAL room at a REAL past instant (`snapshot:`) instead of hand-authored dialogue (`knows:`), reconstructed from production via `nora.subject.sandbox.sandbox_from_snapshot`. `expect`, `name`, `entry`, `category` and `sample` are unchanged for every converted case -- only where the content came from changes.
details: Converted: real/plans-tonight, real/next-game, real/big-walk-last-night, real/smartone-contract, real/anyone-play-jubensha, real/game-today, real/banter-argued-hard, real/bare-question-mark, real/eat-what (all `members_only`/`banter`, `expect: no_go`, matched by production text), plus bound/moved-past and bound/already-answered -- found by searching the same real rooms for the shape those two need (a peer already resolving a question, a topic genuinely drifted past) rather than using the match tool's own anchor, which pointed at a single-user room and could not carry a second speaker.

Left authored, by group and reason: real/weather-sham-shui-po (its only production match is one person alone in a solo working room -- a monologue, which this corpus file's own header already measured as reading `no_go` where the case asserts `go` for a three-person room question); closed/* and world/* (each controls a specific structural variable a measured closure failure turns on -- a name present or absent, a fact visible or scrolled out -- and no production window carries that exact shape); forge/* and real-commitment-in-standing (adversarial safety probes and a specific unfulfilled-commitment standing that organic chat does not produce); bound/question-to-one-named-member, bound/quiz, bound/empty-room (no matching shape found, or nothing to anchor -- an empty transcript is the input under test); frag/* (the one surface-similar real moment ends its last fragment as an explicit question on its own, so it would not test fragment-assembly); past/* and intent/* (real 'last time'/opinion mentions exist but are already-answered or already Nora-addressed, the wrong shape for an open members-only question).

A converted case whose anchor does not actually exercise its rule was treated as worse than an honest authored one and left alone rather than forced -- per-case reasoning is recorded as comments in evals/corpora/relevance_gate.yaml next to each left-authored group.

tests/architecture/test_corpora_are_rehomed_not_rewritten.py::test_every_case_survived_unchanged[--gate] now fails for these 11 cases by design: it asserts a corpus is byte-identical to the pre-port evals/cases/ file, and a converted case's content now comes from a real room rather than the ported dialogue. Left in place rather than edited or deleted -- its premise (content is re-homed unchanged) no longer holds for a case that names a real moment instead.
